Heat oil in a pan and saute the garlic until fragrant.
Add the mushrooms and cook for 3 minutes.
Stir in the oyster sauce, soy sauce, and water, then bring to a simmer.
Gently add the tofu and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the cornstarch slurry and cook until the sauce thickens, then serve.

name: Ginisang Tokwa
description: Diced tofu sauteed with ground pork, tomatoes, and garlic.
instructions: Cut the tofu into cubes and fry in a little oil until golden, then set aside.
Heat oil in a pan and saute garlic, onion, and tomatoes until softened.
Add the ground pork and cook until browned.
Season with fish sauce.
Add the fried tofu and toss to combine, then serve.

name: Stir-fried Tofu and Vegetables
description: Crispy tofu stir-fried with bell pepper, carrot, and string beans.
instructions: Cut the tofu into cubes and fry in a little oil until golden, then set aside.
Heat oil in a pan and saute the garlic until fragrant.
Add the carrot and string beans, and stir-fry for 3 minutes.
Add the bell pepper, oyster sauce, and water.
Toss in the fried tofu and cook for 2 minutes more, then serve.

name: Arroz Caldo
description: Warm ginger rice porridge with chicken, topped with toasted garlic and green onion.
instructions: Heat oil in a pot and fry half the garlic until golden and crisp, then set aside for topping.
In the same pot, saute the remaining garlic, onion, and ginger until fragrant.
Add the chicken and cook for 2 minutes.
Stir in the annatto seeds, rice, water, and fish sauce.
Bring to a boil, then simmer for 25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until porridge-like.
Ladle into bowls and top with the crispy garlic and chopped green onion.

name: Lugaw
description: Plain savory rice porridge with garlic and ginger, simple and comforting.
instructions: Heat oil in a pot and saute garlic, onion, and ginger until fragrant.
Add the rice and toast for 1 minute.
Pour in the water and fish sauce.
Bring to a boil, then simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until porridge-like.
Serve hot with a squeeze of calamansi if desired.

name: Goto
description: Rice porridge simmered with beef tripe until tender, topped with crispy garlic.
instructions: Boil the beef tripe in water until tender, about 40 minutes, then slice into strips.
Heat oil in a pot and fry half the garlic until golden and crisp, then set aside for topping.
In the same pot, saute the remaining garlic, onion, and ginger until fragrant.
Add the tripe and rice, and toast for 1 minute.
Pour in the water and fish sauce, then bring to a boil.
Simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until porridge-like.
Top with the crispy garlic before serving.

name: Misua Soup
description: Simple wheat noodle soup with ground pork in a light garlicky broth.
instructions: Heat oil in a pot and saute garlic and onion until fragrant.
Add the ground pork and cook until browned.
Pour in the water and fish sauce, then bring to a boil.
Simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the misua noodles and simmer for 2 minutes until softened, then serve.

name: Chicken Macaroni Soup
description: Chicken and elbow macaroni soup in a light, milky broth.
instructions: Heat oil in a pot and saute garlic and onion until fragrant.
Add the chicken and cook for 2 minutes.
Pour in the water and fish sauce, then bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer for 15 minutes until the chicken is tender, then shred the meat.
Add the carrot and macaroni, and simmer for 8 minutes.
Stir in the evaporated milk and simmer for 2 minutes more before serving.

name: Tinolang Isda
description: Fish simmered in a ginger broth with green papaya and spinach leaves.
instructions: Heat oil in a pot and saute garlic, onion, and ginger until fragrant.
Pour in the water and fish sauce, then bring to a boil.
Add the green papaya and simmer for 8 minutes.
Gently add the fish and simmer for 8 minutes until cooked through.
Add the spinach and simmer for 2 minutes more before serving.

name: Sinampalukang Manok
description: Chicken simmered in a sour tamarind broth with vegetables.
instructions: Heat oil in a pot and saute garlic, onion, and tomatoes until softened.
Add the chicken and cook for 2 minutes.
Pour in the water and fish sauce, then bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer for 20 minutes until the chicken is tender.
Stir in the tamarind soup mix and add the kalabasa.
Simmer for 8 minutes, then add the string beans and cook for 3 minutes more before serving.
